newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's China Airlines, EVA 1996 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's China Airlines, EVA 1996 profits rise.

text.p: Taiwan's two international carriers -- China Airlines and EVA Airways -- reported sound profits in 1996 due to a booming industry, the China Times said on Thursday.
China Airlines estimated its 1996 pre-tax profit at over T$1.28 billion on record turnover of T$50 billion, the report said.
China Airlines attributed the 1996 rises mainly to the lucrative Taiwan-Hong Kong route, the paper said.
In 1995, China Airlines' sales revenues were T$47.2 billion, the report did not give the firm's 1995 profit figure.

EVA Airways, a unit of shipping giant Evergreen Marine, posted a pre-tax profit of T$600 million on turnover of T$35 billion in 1996, rising sharply from 1995's profit of T$190 million and sales of T$29 billion.
It was the second consecutive year EVA has made profits since it was established in 1991.
The paper quoted EVA President Huang Jen-chung as saying the company hoped to achieve T$40 billion in sales for 1997.
Results for the two companies were unaudited.
Both firms cited good outlooks for 1997, the report said.
